Please make this prompt suno paste ready. 
Create a high-quality, professional-grade AI-generated version of this uplifting pop-rock anthem about overcoming loneliness and embracing freedom. The song should evoke triumph and energy, with outstanding production values: crystal-clear mixing, dynamic range, layered instrumentation, and emotive vocals that build emotional intensity. Use a driving 4/4 tempo at exactly 128 BPM in a major key (suggest E major for brightness), following the harmonic progression I-V-vi-IV for a sense of resolution and uplift.
Genre/Style: High-energy pop-rock with anthemic choruses, blending acoustic intimacy in verses with explosive electric builds. Influences: Imagine Dragons meets Coldplay, with modern pop polish like Ed Sheeran.
Instrumentation and Arrangement:
	•	Start with rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming (clean, palm-muted) and subtle atmospheric synth pads for an intro build.
	•	Layer in distorted electric guitars with overdrive for power chords in choruses.
	•	Punchy bassline locking with the kick drum for groove.
	•	Compressed drum kit: tight kick, prominent cracking snare, shimmering hi-hats, and crashing cymbals with gated reverb for space.
	•	Add piano accents in the bridge for emotional depth.
	•	Synths: Side-chain compressed pads that duck under the kick for pumping energy.
	•	Overall: Wide stereo field with panned guitars, centered vocals, and subtle effects like delay on ad-libs.
Vocals:
	•	Lead: Passionate male tenor (e.g., style of Chris Martin or Dan Reynolds), using chest voice in verses for intimacy and soaring head voice/falsetto in choruses for euphoria.
	•	Harmonies: Multi-layered stacks in choruses and outro, widening the sound with auto-tune for polish but natural vibrato for authenticity.
	•	Delivery: Energetic, confident, with ad-libs like “hey!” in the outro for crowd-engagement feel.
	•	Effects: Light reverb, compression for presence, and doubling in hooks.
Structure:
	•	Intro: 8-16 bars of building acoustic guitar and synths.
	•	Verse-Chorus-Verse-Chorus-Bridge-Chorus-Outro.
	•	Dynamics: Intimate, stripped-back verses (lower volume, fewer instruments); explosive choruses (full band, high energy); contemplative bridge building to a drop; fade-out outro with repeating hooks.
Lyrics (must use exactly, no changes):
[Verse 1] Spent too many nights with silence Shadows filling up my room I’ve been learning to keep fighting But I’m ready for the truth
[Pre-Chorus] Can’t keep waiting My heart’s aching For somebody To set me free
[Chorus] Lonely’s getting old, I’m breaking free No more empty space, it’s time for me I won’t chase the dark, I’ll chase the light I’m done with lonely nights
[Verse 2] Every clock keeps ticking louder I don’t wanna waste more time If love’s a flame, I need the fire To finally make it mine
[Pre-Chorus] Can’t keep waiting My heart’s aching For somebody To set me free
[Chorus] Lonely’s getting old, I’m breaking free No more empty space, it’s time for me I won’t chase the dark, I’ll chase the light I’m done with lonely nights
[Bridge] Lonely had its hold on me But I won’t let it steal the dream I know love is meant to be And it’s calling, calling me
[Chorus – Final] Lonely’s getting old, I’m breaking free No more empty space, it’s time for me I won’t chase the dark, I’ll chase the light I’m done with lonely nights
[Post-Chorus / Outro] Lonely’s getting old (hey!) Lonely’s getting old (hey!) Stronger than before (hey!) I don’t need it anymore
Production Quality Enhancements:
	•	Master for radio-ready loudness (LUFS -8 to -10) with no clipping.
	•	Add subtle crowd cheers or arena reverb in final chorus for live-anthem feel.
	•	Ensure seamless transitions, build-ups with risers, and a satisfying fade-out.
	•	Total length: 3:00-3:30 minutes for pop appeal.
	•	Output in high-fidelity audio: 320kbps MP3 or WAV, with balanced EQ (bright highs, warm mids, tight lows).
